abstract: Mature cystic teratoma is the most common ovarian neoplasm. However, mucinous cystadenoma with teratoma has been very rarely reported in literature. This case report, which is very rare, describes a clinical entity not previously reported in literature. A 34-year-old pregnant woman presented in the 23rd gestational week with severe right lower quadrant pain. She was diagnosed with acute abdomen and was then treated surgically. During the surgical intervention, a spontaneously ruptured mass was detected in the right ovary. This was reported histopathologically as a mature cystic teratoma in collision with mucinous cystadenoma. To the best of our knowledge, this case report is the first to have identified a ruptured mature cystic teratoma in collision with mucinous cystadenoma in a pregnant woman.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣の最も一般的な腫瘍である。しかし、粘液性嚢胞腺腫と奇形腫の合併は文献上ごく稀にしか報告されていない。この極めて稀な症例報告は、これまで文献に報告されていない臨床像を記述するものである。34歳の妊婦が妊娠23週に強い右下腹部痛で受診した。急性腹症と診断され、外科的治療を受けた。手術中に右卵巣に自然破裂した腫瘤が認められた。病理組織学的に、粘液性嚢胞腺腫と衝突した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と報告された。我々の知る限り、本症例報告は、妊婦における破裂性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と粘液性嚢胞腺腫の衝突例を初めて同定したものである。
